notes.title: Japanese Language Update + DIGITAL EXORCIST World Premiere Demo at BitSummit!
notes.content: [h3]Now Available in Japanese![/h3][p][b]DIGITAL EXORCIST case_(0);[/b] has just been updated with Japanese language support![/p][p]The localization was handled by renowned translator Yosei Mutou, known for work on acclaimed titles such as [b]VA-11 Hall-A[/b] and [b]Gone Home[/b].[/p][p]This update coincides with the news that [b]DIGITAL EXORCIST[/b], the upcoming sequel from COOL BEANS PRODUCTIONS, is now officially published by HYPER REAL.[/p][p]The full game is planned for release in 2026 on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2944390/DIGITAL_EXORCIST/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]DIGITAL EXORCIST Demo at BitSummit the 13th![/h3][p]The sequel to [b]DIGITAL EXORCIST case_(0);[/b], [b]DIGITAL EXORCIST[/b], will have its world premiere demo at BitSummit the 13th, held in Kyoto from July 18 to 20, 2025. The demo will be playable in both English and Japanese. Other titles that will be featured at the booth include [b]SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim[/b], [b]SKY THE SCRAPER[/b], and [b]Telebbit[/b]. Come by the booth, try out our games, and grab some exclusive merch while supplies last! [/p][p][/p][h3]Exhibition Overview[/h3][quote][p][b]Dates:[/b] 2025/7/18 (FRI) - 2025/7/20 (SUN) 10:00 - 17:00 [/p][p][b]Venue:[/b] Kyoto Kangyo-Kan "Miyako Messe", 1F, Exhibition Hall 2[/p][p][b]Booth Name:[/b] HYPER REAL [/p][p][b]Booth Location:[/b] IP2-16[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy the new language support, and we look forward to seeing you at BitSummit![/p][p]COOL BEANS PRODUCTIONS & HYPER REAL[/p]

notes.title: URGENT UPDATE ON CASE FILE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43954533/a59bbf92dc50a93c66b2da68d402886f377e1c73.png[/img]
[b]GREETINGS DIGITAL RIDER. A DIGITAL ANOMALY HAS BEEN DETECTED. WE REQUIRE YOU TO DIVE INTO OUR CASE FILES ONCE MORE. INTEL SUGGESTS THAT OUR PREVIOUS REPORTS ARE FAULTY. PLEASE CONFIRM THE FOLLOWING:[/b]

[list]
[*] Make sure your actions are properly [i]ACHIEVED[/i].
[*] Rendezvous with your high-ranking field agent [i]AT THE END OF THIS MISSION ASAP.[/i]
[*] Await [i]further [/i]instructions.
[/list]

[b]DEFRAG. DESTROY. DELIVER.[/b]
-DATA Director Roger D. Kooglass
